sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Carlos T. Mootz De Arbeloa.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Mootz De Arbeloa worked for the American Fork Police Department from July 15, 2024 to October 13, 2025.

sections.title: Education & Training
descriptions: The Salt Lake Community College 2025 commencement program lists Carlos Mootz de Arbeloa among its Law Enforcement Academy graduates, under Law Enforcement Officer, LEO 105, Certificate of Completion.
